what: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce is one of Canada's big six banks. It focuses more heavily on Canadian personal and business banking than its peers, and also runs a US commercial bank and wealth business.
customers: Canadian households and small businesses, Canadian and US commercial clients, and wealth management customers.
money: deposits, mortgages and small business lending
US commercial lending and private wealth
moat: A share of the Canadian banking oligopoly, with deposit relationships that rarely move.
risks: The highest exposure to Canadian mortgages among the big banks
Canadian house prices and household debt are a concentrated risk
US commercial property lending losses have been elevated
Less geographic diversification than its peers
opportunities: Revenue grew about 13% last year with a 29% net margin
Canadian mortgage renewals have so far performed better than feared
A dividend yield near 3% with consistent increases
watch: Canadian mortgage delinquencies and US commercial property provisions.
